attributes.board_name: Oregon Board of Licensed Professional Counselors and Therapists

rules.accepted_credit_types: Accredited college courses (15 h per semester credit); live seminars/workshops/conferences by counseling-related departments of accredited institutions, recognized professional organizations or human-services agencies; home study (1 h per 6,000 words); Board/committee service. Publications and presentations max 20 h; officer roles and paid supervision received max 10 h.
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE reporting for licensees licensed 12 months or less on their first renewal date.
rules.audit_note: Random audits; keep documentation for at least 2 years after the reporting period. Late response or deficient hours draw fines ($200–$1,000) and possible suspension.

topics.who: Professional ethics and/or Oregon laws and rules for counseling/MFT practice
Suicide risk assessment, treatment and management
Licensees who supervise registered associates, incl. everyone on the Supervisor Registry

rules.notes: Biennial renewal; licenses expire the last day of the birth month (renew up to 45 days before or during that month). No cap on home-study hours.
rules.rule_quote: (2) Licensees must complete at least 40 continuing education clock hours within each reporting period…
